$comment: Published video tutorials, read by Nodus when a user opens a tutorial grid (see shared/tutorialVideos.ts). Adding an entry here reaches installed copies without a release. Rules the app enforces on this file: `id` is a lowercase slug, `youtubeId` must be exactly 11 YouTube-id characters, `order` sets the position within its shelf, `category` is one of introduction/vaults/features/integrations (a missing one falls back to the built-in entry, or to vaults when `vaultType` is named and to features otherwise), `icon` must be one of the allowed names (play, network, archive, sparkles, graduation, layers, tree, table, chartBar, microphone, image, tools, star, file, book, plug, puzzle, globe, link), `vaultType` may name a vault so its tour offers the video, and `copy` carries the title/description per language (es, en, fr, tr, de, it, pt, pt-BR, zh, ja, ru, uk). A new entry with no usable copy is dropped; a built-in id may omit copy and keep the translations compiled into the app. Malformed entries are ignored one by one, and this file can never hide a tutorial the app already ships.
